question.html:
A planet is in an elliptical orbit around a star. 

P and Q are points along the planet’s orbit. 

Consider the following statements:

I. The linear speed of the planet is less at Q than at P.

II. The orbital period of the planet is proportional to the square of the distance between P and Q.

III. The gravitational force exerted by the planet on the star is the greatest at P.

Which of these statements are correct?

  1. I and II only
  2. I and III only
  3. II and III only
  4. I, II and III
